stem.en: In "We have a break at ten", what is a "break"?

options.en: a test at the end of the week
a book for your maths lessons
the first lesson of the day

why.en: A break is a short rest between lessons: you can eat, talk or play.
why.uz: Break — tanaffus, yaʼni darslar orasidagi qisqa dam olish vaqti.
why.ru: Break — перемена, короткий отдых между уроками.

stem.en: Choose the word: "Our teacher gives us ___ on Monday. We do it at home."

why.en: School work that you do at home is homework.
why.uz: Uyda bajariladigan maktab ishi — homework (uy vazifasi).
why.ru: Школьная работа, которую делают дома, — homework (домашнее задание).

stem.en: What is a "classmate"?

why.en: A classmate is a student in your class, not your teacher.
why.uz: Classmate — sinfdosh, yaʼni sinfingizdagi oʻquvchi.
why.ru: Classmate — одноклассник, ученик из твоего класса.

stem.en: Choose the word: "Look at the ___. We have English at nine o'clock."

why.en: A timetable shows your lessons and their times, so it tells you when English is.
why.uz: Timetable — dars jadvali: unda qaysi dars qachon boʻlishi yozilgan.
why.ru: Timetable — расписание: в нём видно, какой урок и когда.

stem.en: Choose the word: "We have eight ___ at school, and music is one of them."

why.en: Music is one of the things you study at school: it is a subject.
why.uz: Musiqa maktabda oʻqitiladigan fanlardan biri, yaʼni subject.
why.ru: Музыка — один из школьных предметов, то есть subject.

stem.en: Choose the word: "We ___ a break at eleven o'clock."

why.en: We say "have a break": we have a short rest between lessons.
why.uz: Inglizchada «have a break» deyiladi: darslar orasida qisqa dam olmoq.
why.ru: По-английски говорят «have a break»: отдыхать на перемене.

stem.en: Choose the right word: "My two ___ live near the school."

why.en: After "two" we need the plural: classmates.
why.uz: «two» (ikki) soʻzidan keyin koʻplik shakli kerak: classmates.
why.ru: После «two» нужно множественное число: classmates.

stem.en: Which sentence uses "homework" correctly?

options.en: Our homework is on page twelve.
I have two homeworks for Monday.
She has a homework in English.

why.en: Homework has no plural and takes no "a": we say "our homework", not "homeworks".
why.uz: Homework sanalmaydi: «a homework» yoki «homeworks» deyilmaydi.
why.ru: Homework — неисчисляемое: нельзя сказать «a homework» или «homeworks».

stem.en: Which one is a school "subject"?

why.en: History is something you study at school, so it is a subject.
why.uz: Tarix (history) maktabda oʻqitiladigan fan, yaʼni subject.
why.ru: История (history) — то, что изучают в школе, то есть subject.

stem.en: Choose the word: "Nodira and I are in class 6B. She is my ___, and we often do our homework together."

why.en: Nodira is in the same class, so she is a classmate.
why.uz: Nodira bir sinfda oʻqiydi, demak u classmate, yaʼni sinfdosh.
why.ru: Нодира учится в том же классе, значит, она classmate — одноклассница.

stem.en: Who are your "parents"?

why.en: Your parents are your mother and your father.
why.uz: Parents — ota-ona, yaʼni onangiz va otangiz.
why.ru: Parents — родители: мама и папа.

stem.en: Choose the word: "Saturday and Sunday are the ___."

why.en: Saturday and Sunday together are the weekend.
why.uz: Shanba va yakshanba — weekend, yaʼni dam olish kunlari.
why.ru: Суббота и воскресенье — это weekend, выходные.

stem.en: Choose the word: "My mother likes to ___ plov for the family."

why.en: To cook is to make food ready to eat, so you cook plov.
why.uz: Cook — ovqat pishirmoq: plov pishiriladi.
why.ru: Cook — готовить еду: плов готовят.

stem.en: Choose the word: "Bekzod is ten and his sister is seven. She is ___ than Bekzod."

why.en: Seven is less than ten, so the sister is younger. Before "than" we use the -er form.
why.uz: Yetti oʻndan kam, demak singlisi younger (yoshi kichikroq). «than» oldidan -er shakli keladi.
why.ru: Семь меньше десяти, значит, сестра younger (младше). Перед «than» нужна форма на -er.

stem.en: In "We eat dinner together", what does "together" mean?

options.en: in a quiet room with the TV on

why.en: Together means with other people: the family eats at the same table.
why.uz: Together — birga, yaʼni yolgʻiz emas, boshqalar bilan.
why.ru: Together — вместе, то есть не в одиночку, а с другими.

stem.en: Choose the word: "Lola lives with her ___ and her grandmother. Her mother is a teacher."

why.en: Her mother and father are her parents.
why.uz: Onasi va otasi — uning parents, yaʼni ota-onasi.
why.ru: Мама и папа — это её parents, родители.

stem.en: Choose the right word: "My grandmother ___ lunch for us every day."

why.en: With he, she or "my grandmother" in the present simple, the verb takes -s: cooks.
why.uz: Present simple da u (he, she) bilan feʼlga -s qoʻshiladi: cooks.
why.ru: В present simple с he, she к глаголу добавляется -s: cooks.

stem.en: Which sentence uses "together" correctly?

options.en: My sister and I play together.
I play together in my room.
She is together than her brother.
We together to the park on Friday.

why.en: Together needs two or more people doing one thing: my sister and I play together.
why.uz: Together uchun kamida ikki kishi kerak: singlim va men birga oʻynaymiz.
why.ru: Для together нужны двое или больше: мы с сестрой играем вместе.

stem.en: What does "cook" mean?

options.en: to make food ready to eat
to wash plates after a meal
to buy food at the bazaar

why.en: To cook is to make food ready to eat, for example soup or plov.
why.uz: Cook — ovqat pishirmoq, masalan shoʻrva yoki plov.
why.ru: Cook — готовить еду, например суп или плов.

stem.en: Choose the word: "My cousin Zarina is younger ___ me."

why.en: After younger, older or taller we use "than": younger than me.
why.uz: younger, older kabi soʻzlardan keyin than keladi: younger than me.
why.ru: После younger, older и т. п. ставим than: younger than me.

stem.en: What does "fresh" mean in "fresh bread"?

options.en: from a big shop in the city

why.en: Fresh bread is new and good to eat, not old.
why.uz: Fresh — yangi: yangi pishgan, eskirmagan non.
why.ru: Fresh — свежий: хлеб новый, не чёрствый.

stem.en: Choose the word: "The box is big. I cannot ___ it to the car alone."

why.en: To carry is to hold something and take it with you, like a box to the car.
why.uz: Carry — koʻtarib olib bormoq, masalan qutini mashinaga.
why.ru: Carry — нести: взять в руки и отнести, например коробку к машине.

stem.en: Choose the word: "I want to ___ a new pen. How much is it?"

why.en: You ask "How much is it?" when you want to buy something.
why.uz: «How much is it?» (Qancha turadi?) deb biror narsani sotib olmoqchi boʻlganda soʻraymiz: buy.
why.ru: «How much is it?» спрашивают, когда хотят что-то купить: buy.

stem.en: Choose the word: "This bag costs a lot of money. It is not ___."

why.en: A thing that costs a lot is not cheap: cheap means it does not cost much.
why.uz: Qimmat narsa cheap (arzon) emas: cheap — koʻp pul turmaydigan.
why.ru: Дорогая вещь не cheap: cheap значит «стоит недорого».

stem.en: Choose the right word: "I do not have ___ money for a ticket."

why.en: Money has no plural, so we say "much money", not "many money".
why.uz: Money sanalmaydigan ot: «much money» deyiladi, «many money» emas.
why.ru: Money — неисчисляемое: говорят «much money», а не «many money».

stem.en: Choose the word: "These apples are ___. They are from the garden this morning."

why.en: Apples from the garden this morning are new and good to eat: fresh.
why.uz: Bugun ertalab bogʻdan uzilgan olma — fresh, yaʼni yangi.
why.ru: Яблоки, сорванные сегодня утром, — fresh, то есть свежие.

stem.en: Choose the right form: "Every Sunday my father ___ meat at the bazaar."

why.en: "My father" is he, so the present simple verb takes -s: buys.
why.uz: My father — u (he), shuning uchun present simple da feʼl -s oladi: buys.
why.ru: My father — это he, поэтому в present simple глагол с -s: buys.

stem.en: Which sentence uses "carry" correctly?

options.en: I carry my little sister's bag.
I carry to school by bus.
She carry the heavy box every day.
We are carry the bags home.

why.en: Carry needs a thing after it (the bag), and with "I" there is no -s.
why.uz: Carry dan keyin narsa keladi (the bag), I bilan esa -s qoʻshilmaydi.
why.ru: После carry нужен предмет (the bag), а с I окончание -s не нужно.

stem.en: What does "buy" mean?

options.en: to get a thing and pay for it
to give a present to a friend
to make a thing at home
to look at things in a shop window

why.en: To buy is to get a thing and pay money for it.
why.uz: Buy — sotib olmoq: narsani olib, uning pulini toʻlamoq.
why.ru: Buy — покупать: получить вещь и заплатить за неё.

stem.en: What is the opposite of "cheap"?

why.en: Cheap things cost little money; expensive things cost a lot.
why.uz: Cheap — arzon, expensive — qimmat: ular bir-biriga qarama-qarshi.
why.ru: Cheap — дешёвый, expensive — дорогой: это противоположности.

stem.en: Who is a "coach"?

options.en: a person who teaches a sport
a person who sells sports clothes
a player who is very fast

why.en: A coach teaches a sport and helps the players to get better.
why.uz: Coach — murabbiy, yaʼni sportni oʻrgatadigan odam.
why.ru: Coach — тренер, человек, который учит спорту.

stem.en: Choose the word: "There are five players in our ___. We play basketball."

why.en: A group of players who play together is a team.
why.uz: Birga oʻynaydigan oʻyinchilar guruhi — team, yaʼni jamoa.
why.ru: Группа игроков, которые играют вместе, — team, команда.

stem.en: Choose the word: "I run for one hour, and now I am very ___."

why.en: After a long run you need to rest, so you are tired.
why.uz: Uzoq yugurishdan keyin dam olish kerak: tired, yaʼni charchagan.
why.ru: После долгого бега нужно отдохнуть: tired — уставший.

stem.en: Choose the word: "Dilnoza wants to play the dutar well, so she ___ every evening."

why.en: To get better, she plays it many times: she practises.
why.uz: Yaxshiroq chalish uchun koʻp marta takrorlaydi: practises, yaʼni mashq qiladi.
why.ru: Чтобы играть лучше, она много раз повторяет: practises — тренируется.

stem.en: What is the opposite of "win"?

why.en: If one team wins, the other team loses: lose is the opposite of win.
why.uz: Bir jamoa yutsa (win), ikkinchisi yutqazadi (lose): ular qarama-qarshi.
why.ru: Если одна команда выигрывает (win), другая проигрывает (lose).

stem.en: Choose the word: "The ___ tells us to run to the gate and back."

why.en: The person who tells the players what to do is the coach.
why.uz: Oʻyinchilarga nima qilishni aytadigan odam — coach (murabbiy).
why.ru: Человек, который говорит игрокам, что делать, — coach (тренер).

stem.en: Choose the right word: "My brother Sardor often ___ at chess."

why.en: Sardor is he, so in the present simple the verb takes -s: wins.
why.uz: Sardor — u (he), shuning uchun present simple da feʼl -s oladi: wins.
why.ru: Сардор — это he, поэтому в present simple нужно -s: wins.

stem.en: Which sentence uses "practise" correctly?

options.en: We are practise in the park.
She practise the piano every evening.

why.en: Practise is a verb: we practise football. With "she" it needs -s (practises).
why.uz: Practise — feʼl: we practise football. She bilan -s qoʻshiladi: practises.
why.ru: Practise — глагол: we practise football. С she нужно -s: practises.

stem.en: What does "win" mean?

options.en: to be the best in a game
to watch a game on TV
to play for a long time

why.en: To win is to be the best in a game or a race.
why.uz: Win — yutmoq, yaʼni oʻyinda eng yaxshi boʻlmoq.
why.ru: Win — выигрывать, быть лучшим в игре.

stem.en: Choose the right word: "The long game makes us very ___."

why.en: After "makes us very" we need the adjective tired: we need to rest.
why.uz: «makes us very» dan keyin sifat kerak: tired, yaʼni charchagan.
why.ru: После «makes us very» нужно прилагательное tired — уставший.

stem.en: What does "late" mean?

why.en: Late means after the right time: the lesson has started.
why.uz: Late — kech qolgan: dars allaqachon boshlangan.
why.ru: Late — опоздавший, поздно: урок уже начался.

stem.en: Choose the word: "My grandmother lives in another city. It is very ___ from here."

why.en: Another city is a long way from here, so it is far.
why.uz: Boshqa shahar bu yerdan uzoqda: far, yaʼni uzoq.
why.ru: Другой город далеко отсюда: far — далеко.

stem.en: Choose the word: "Aziza leaves home ___, at six o'clock, before her family gets up."

why.en: Six o'clock, before the family gets up, is before the usual time: early.
why.uz: Soat oltida, oiladagilar turmasdan oldin chiqish — early, yaʼni erta.
why.ru: Уйти в шесть, пока семья ещё спит, — early, рано.

stem.en: Choose the word: "The small shop is ___ with people today."

why.en: Full of people is crowded: we say "crowded with people".
why.uz: Odamga toʻla joy — crowded: «crowded with people» deyiladi.
why.ru: Полный людей — crowded: говорят «crowded with people».

stem.en: Choose the word: "We wait ___ the bus at the corner."

why.en: We say "wait for": wait for the bus, wait for a friend.
why.uz: Inglizchada wait for deyiladi: wait for the bus — avtobusni kutmoq.
why.ru: Говорят wait for: wait for the bus — ждать автобус.

stem.en: In "Do not be late", what must you do?

why.en: "Do not be late" means come at the right time, not after it.
why.uz: «Do not be late» — kech qolmang, yaʼni oʻz vaqtida keling.
why.ru: «Do not be late» — не опаздывай, то есть приходи вовремя.

stem.en: Choose the word: "Our music lesson begins at nine. Bobur comes at ten past nine, so he is ___."

why.en: Ten past nine is after nine, the start of the lesson, so Bobur is late.
why.uz: Soat toʻqqizu oʻn daqiqa — dars boshlanganidan keyin: Bobur late, yaʼni kech qolgan.
why.ru: Девять десять — после начала урока в девять, значит, Бобур late — опоздал.

stem.en: Which sentence uses "far" correctly?

options.en: Is the station far from here?
We get up far in the morning.
She is far for school every day.
The bus is far of people today.

why.en: Far means a long way: "far from here". It does not mean early, late or full.
why.uz: Far — uzoq: «far from here» (bu yerdan uzoq). U erta, kech yoki toʻla degani emas.
why.ru: Far — далеко: «far from here». Это не «рано», не «поздно» и не «полный».

stem.en: What does "early" mean?

options.en: at the same time every day

why.en: Early means before the usual time, for example getting up at five.
why.uz: Early — erta, yaʼni odatdagi vaqtdan oldin.
why.ru: Early — рано, то есть раньше обычного времени.

stem.en: Choose the right word: "In the morning the metro is very ___."

why.en: After "is very" we need an adjective: crowded, full of people.
why.uz: «is very» dan keyin sifat kerak: crowded, yaʼni odam koʻp.
why.ru: После «is very» нужно прилагательное: crowded — переполненный.

stem.en: What is a "canteen" at school?

options.en: a room where pupils have lunch
a room where pupils do sport
a place where pupils buy books
the room of the head teacher

why.en: The canteen is the room at school where pupils eat lunch.
why.uz: Canteen — maktab oshxonasi, oʻquvchilar tushlik qiladigan joy.
why.ru: Canteen — школьная столовая, где ученики обедают.

stem.en: Choose the word: "It is one o'clock and I want to eat. I am ___."

why.en: When you want to eat, you are hungry.
why.uz: Ovqat yegingiz kelsa — hungry, yaʼni qorningiz och.
why.ru: Когда хочется есть, ты hungry — голодный.

stem.en: What does "favourite" mean?

options.en: the one you do not like
the one that is very big

why.en: Your favourite is the one you like best of all.
why.uz: Favourite — eng sevimli, yaʼni hammasidan koʻproq yoqadigani.
why.ru: Favourite — любимый, то есть тот, что нравится больше всего.

stem.en: Choose the word: "Six friends and only four plates! We do not have ___ plates."

why.en: Four plates for six friends are not as many as you need: not enough.
why.uz: Olti doʻstga toʻrtta likopcha yetmaydi: not enough, yaʼni yetarli emas.
why.ru: Четырёх тарелок на шестерых мало: not enough — недостаточно.

stem.en: Choose the word: "Malika has a big cake. She ___ it with her friends."

why.en: To share is to give a part of your thing to others: she shares the cake.
why.uz: Share — boʻlishmoq: tortdan doʻstlariga ham beradi.
why.ru: Share — делиться: она даёт друзьям часть торта.

stem.en: Choose the word: "The ___ is on the first floor, next to the gym."

why.en: A room on the first floor is a place: the canteen, where pupils eat.
why.uz: Birinchi qavatdagi xona — canteen, yaʼni maktab oshxonasi.
why.ru: Комната на первом этаже — это canteen, школьная столовая.

stem.en: Choose the word: "Can I share this book ___ you?"

why.en: We say "share something with somebody": share this book with you.
why.uz: Inglizchada share … with deyiladi: kitobni siz bilan boʻlishmoq.
why.ru: Говорят share … with: делиться книгой с тобой.

stem.en: Which sentence uses "enough" correctly?

options.en: We have enough bread for lunch.
We have bread enough hungry today.
She is enough tall for the team.
We have enough not water today.

why.en: Enough goes before a noun: enough bread. After an adjective: tall enough.
why.uz: Enough otdan oldin keladi: enough bread. Sifatdan keyin keladi: tall enough.
why.ru: Enough стоит перед существительным: enough bread, но после прилагательного: tall enough.

stem.en: Choose the word: "Football is my ___ game. I like it more than all other games."

why.en: The game you like more than all others is your favourite.
why.uz: Hammasidan koʻproq yoqadigan oʻyin — favourite, yaʼni eng sevimli.
why.ru: Игра, которая нравится больше всех, — favourite, любимая.

stem.en: Choose the right word: "The children are ___ after the long game, so they eat quickly."

why.en: After "are" we need an adjective: hungry, wanting to eat.
why.uz: «are» dan keyin sifat kerak: hungry, yaʼni qorni och.
why.ru: После «are» нужно прилагательное: hungry — голодный.

stem.en: What is a "souvenir"?

options.en: a thing to remind you of a trip
a ticket for a train or a bus
a map that shows old buildings
a person who shows a city

why.en: A souvenir is a small thing you keep to remember a place you visited.
why.uz: Souvenir — esdalik sovgʻasi: borgan joyingizni eslatib turadigan narsa.
why.ru: Souvenir — сувенир: вещь, которая напоминает о поездке.

stem.en: Choose the word: "Our ___ showed us the old mosque and told us its story."

why.en: A person who shows a place and tells its story is a guide.
why.uz: Joyni koʻrsatib, uning tarixini aytib beradigan odam — guide (gid).
why.ru: Человек, который показывает место и рассказывает о нём, — guide (гид).

stem.en: Choose the word: "Next Friday our class is going on an ___ to the zoo."

why.en: A short trip to see a place is an excursion: we go on an excursion.
why.uz: Biror joyni koʻrish uchun qisqa sayohat — excursion: «go on an excursion».
why.ru: Короткая поездка, чтобы посмотреть место, — excursion: «go on an excursion».

stem.en: Choose the word: "These walls are more than a thousand years old. They are ___."

why.en: Something more than a thousand years old is ancient: very old.
why.uz: Ming yildan ortiq yoshli narsa — ancient, yaʼni qadimiy.
why.ru: То, чему больше тысячи лет, — ancient, древнее.

stem.en: Choose the right word: "Yesterday the teacher ___ the new words to us."

why.en: "Yesterday" means the past, so we need the past simple: explained.
why.uz: Yesterday (kecha) — oʻtgan zamon, shuning uchun past simple kerak: explained.
why.ru: Yesterday — прошлое, поэтому нужен past simple: explained.

stem.en: What does "explain" mean?

options.en: to make something easy to understand
to say that you are sorry
to ask a lot of questions
to tell somebody to be quiet in class

why.en: To explain is to make something easy to understand, as a teacher does.
why.uz: Explain — tushuntirmoq: biror narsani oson tushunarli qilmoq.
why.ru: Explain — объяснять: делать что-то понятным.

stem.en: Choose the word: "Zarina bought a small clay bird at the market. It is a ___ of her trip to Khiva."

why.en: A small thing she bought to remember Khiva is a souvenir.
why.uz: Xivani eslab yurish uchun olingan kichik narsa — souvenir (esdalik sovgʻasi).
why.ru: Маленькая вещь, купленная на память о Хиве, — souvenir.

stem.en: Which sentence uses "guide" correctly?

options.en: Our guide spoke about the old walls.
The museum was very guide and old.
She guide us around the city yesterday.
We guide the old walls on Sunday.

why.en: Here a guide is a person who shows a place: our guide spoke about the walls.
why.uz: Bu yerda guide — joyni koʻrsatadigan odam: gidimiz devorlar haqida gapirdi.
why.ru: Здесь guide — человек, который показывает место: наш гид рассказал о стенах.

stem.en: Choose the word: "The ___ to the waterfall was long, but we saw beautiful places."

why.en: A trip to see a place, like a waterfall, is an excursion.
why.uz: Biror joyni, masalan sharsharani koʻrish uchun safar — excursion.
why.ru: Поездка, чтобы посмотреть место, например водопад, — excursion.

stem.en: In "an ancient tower", which words are closest in meaning to "ancient"?

why.en: Ancient means very old, from a time long ago.
why.uz: Ancient — qadimiy, yaʼni juda eski, uzoq oʻtmishdan qolgan.
why.ru: Ancient — древний, то есть очень старый.

stem.en: What does "proud" mean?

options.en: happy about something good you did
sad because you lost a game
worried about the next difficult exam

why.en: You feel proud when you or somebody close to you did something good.
why.uz: Proud — faxrlanadigan: oʻzingiz yoki yaqiningiz yaxshi ish qilganda.
why.ru: Proud — гордый: так чувствуешь себя, когда ты или близкий сделал что-то хорошее.

stem.en: Choose the word: "My voice shakes when I speak in front of the class. I feel ___."

why.en: When your voice shakes and you are worried, you feel nervous.
why.uz: Ovoz titrasa va xavotir boʻlsa — nervous, yaʼni hayajonlangan.
why.ru: Когда голос дрожит от волнения, ты nervous — нервничаешь.

stem.en: Choose the word: "Twenty schools took part in the chess ___ in Bukhara."

why.en: An event where many schools try to be the best is a competition.
why.uz: Koʻp maktab eng yaxshi boʻlishga harakat qiladigan tadbir — competition (musobaqa).
why.ru: Событие, где школы борются за первое место, — competition (соревнование).

stem.en: Choose the word: "Our team won the game, and the ___ was a big cup."

why.en: What you get when you win is a prize, here a big cup.
why.uz: Gʻalaba uchun beriladigan narsa — prize (sovrin), bu yerda katta kubok.
why.ru: То, что получают за победу, — prize (приз), здесь большой кубок.

stem.en: Choose the word: "We need to ___ for the concert. Let us practise every day this week."

why.en: To prepare is to get ready: practise every day before the concert.
why.uz: Prepare — tayyorlanmoq: konsertdan oldin har kuni mashq qilish.
why.ru: Prepare — готовиться: репетировать каждый день перед концертом.

stem.en: Choose the word: "My parents are proud ___ me because I helped my grandmother."

why.en: We say "proud of somebody": my parents are proud of me.
why.uz: Inglizchada proud of deyiladi: ota-onam men bilan faxrlanadi.
why.ru: Говорят proud of: родители гордятся мной.

stem.en: Choose the right word: "Kamila is ___ for her English exam now, so she cannot come out."

why.en: With "is" and "now" we use the -ing form: she is preparing.
why.uz: «is» va «now» bilan -ing shakli keladi: she is preparing (hozir tayyorlanyapti).
why.ru: С is и now нужна форма на -ing: she is preparing.

stem.en: Which sentence uses "nervous" correctly?

options.en: I was nervous before the interview.
The test made me very nervously.
She nervous every time she sings.
My brother is nervous of win the prize.

why.en: Nervous is an adjective after "be": I was nervous. Nervously is an adverb.
why.uz: Nervous — sifat, be feʼlidan keyin keladi: I was nervous. Nervously — ravish.
why.ru: Nervous — прилагательное после be: I was nervous. Nervously — наречие.

stem.en: What is a "prize"?

options.en: something you get when you win
money you pay for a ticket
a test at the end of a year
a book you read before a big exam

why.en: A prize is what you get when you win, for example a medal or a book.
why.uz: Prize — mukofot, sovrin: gʻolib boʻlganda beriladigan narsa.
why.ru: Prize — приз: то, что получаешь за победу.

stem.en: Choose the word: "Akmal worked hard all year and won a medal. His grandfather told everyone about it. He was very ___."

why.en: Telling everyone about a grandson's medal shows a happy feeling: proud.
why.uz: Nevarasining medali haqida hammaga aytib yurish — proud, yaʼni faxrlanish.
why.ru: Рассказывать всем о медали внука — значит гордиться: proud.

stem.en: What does "sweep" mean?

options.en: to clean the floor with a brush
to wash the dishes after dinner
to put clothes in a bag
to give water to the flowers

why.en: To sweep is to clean a floor or a yard with a brush.
why.uz: Sweep — supurmoq: polni yoki hovlini supurgi bilan tozalamoq.
why.ru: Sweep — подметать: чистить пол или двор щёткой.

stem.en: Choose the word: "My little brother ___ his rabbits twice a day."

why.en: To feed an animal is to give it food.
why.uz: Feed — hayvonga ovqat bermoq, boqmoq.
why.ru: Feed — кормить: давать животному еду.

stem.en: Choose the word: "Washing the dishes and making the beds are my ___."

why.en: Small jobs at home, like washing dishes, are chores.
why.uz: Uydagi kichik ishlar, masalan idish yuvish — chores (uy ishlari).
why.ru: Мелкие дела по дому, как мытьё посуды, — chores (домашние дела).

stem.en: Choose the word: "The film ___ at nine, and then we went to bed."

why.en: To finish is to come to the end: the film ended at nine.
why.uz: Finish — tugamoq: film soat toʻqqizda tugadi.
why.ru: Finish — заканчиваться: фильм закончился в девять.

stem.en: Choose the word: "I did not want to watch TV, so I read a book ___."

why.en: Instead means in the place of another thing: a book in the place of TV.
why.uz: Instead — oʻrniga: televizor oʻrniga kitob.
why.ru: Instead — вместо этого: книга вместо телевизора.

stem.en: Choose the word: "Can you help me ___ the chores? I want to finish before lunch."

why.en: We say "help somebody with something": help me with the chores.
why.uz: Inglizchada help … with deyiladi: help me with the chores.
why.ru: Говорят help … with: помоги мне с домашними делами.

stem.en: Choose the right word: "Yesterday I ___ the whole yard, and my arms were tired."

why.en: Sweep is irregular: its past form is swept, not "sweeped".
why.uz: Sweep — notoʻgʻri feʼl: oʻtgan zamon shakli swept, «sweeped» emas.
why.ru: Sweep — неправильный глагол: прошедшее время swept, а не «sweeped».

stem.en: Choose the right word: "When I ___ my homework, I will help you in the garden."

why.en: After "when", about the future, we use the present: When I finish …, I will help.
why.uz: Kelajak haqida gapirganda when dan keyin hozirgi zamon ishlatiladi: When I finish …
why.ru: После when о будущем используют настоящее время: When I finish …

stem.en: In "I had tea instead of juice", what did I drink?

why.en: "Instead of juice" means in the place of juice: I drank tea, not juice.
why.uz: Instead of juice — sharbat oʻrniga: men sharbat emas, choy ichdim.
why.ru: Instead of juice — вместо сока: я пил чай, а не сок.

stem.en: Which sentence uses "chores" correctly?

options.en: I do my chores before I go out.
She chores the floor every day.
We have three chore to do today.
My chores is very easy today.

why.en: Chores is a plural noun: we do our chores, and we say "chores are", not "chores is".
why.uz: Chores — koʻplikdagi ot: «do my chores» deyiladi, «chores is» emas.
why.ru: Chores — существительное во множественном числе: do my chores, а не «chores is».

stem.en: What is a "screen"?

options.en: the flat front part of a phone or TV
the small button on the side of a phone

why.en: The screen is the flat front part of a phone or a TV, where you see pictures.
why.uz: Screen — ekran: telefon yoki televizorning tasvir koʻrinadigan old qismi.
why.ru: Screen — экран: плоская передняя часть телефона или телевизора.

stem.en: Choose the word: "My aunt sent me a short ___: she is coming at six."

why.en: A short text you send to somebody is a message.
why.uz: Kimgadir yuboriladigan qisqa matn — message (xabar).
why.ru: Короткий текст, который отправляют кому-то, — message (сообщение).

stem.en: Choose the word: "This map is very ___. It shows every street in the city."

why.en: A map that shows every street helps you, so it is useful.
why.uz: Har bir koʻchani koʻrsatadigan xarita yordam beradi: useful, yaʼni foydali.
why.ru: Карта, где видна каждая улица, помогает: useful — полезная.

stem.en: Choose the words: "Can you ___ the music? I need to sleep."

why.en: To turn off a machine is to make it stop working: no music, so I can sleep.
why.uz: Turn off — oʻchirmoq: musiqani oʻchirsangiz, uxlay olaman.
why.ru: Turn off — выключать: выключи музыку, чтобы я мог спать.

stem.en: In "Do not waste your money on sweets", what does "waste" mean?

options.en: use it badly, for nothing useful
put it in the bank for a long time

why.en: To waste money is to use it badly, on things you do not need.
why.uz: Waste — bekorga sarflamoq: pulni keraksiz narsalarga sarflash.
why.ru: Waste — тратить впустую: тратить деньги на ненужное.

stem.en: Choose the word: "I ___ two hours on games yesterday, and I did not finish my homework."

why.en: Two hours on games and no homework is time used badly: I wasted it.
why.uz: Oʻyinlarga ikki soat ketib, vazifa qolib ketdi — vaqt bekorga ketdi: wasted.
why.ru: Два часа на игры и несделанное задание — время потрачено впустую: wasted.

stem.en: Choose the right words: "My sister always ___ the lights when she leaves a room."

why.en: "My sister" is she, so the verb takes -s: turns off (not "turn offs").
why.uz: My sister — u (she), shuning uchun feʼlga -s qoʻshiladi: turns off.
why.ru: My sister — это she, поэтому глагол с -s: turns off (а не turn offs).

stem.en: Which sentence uses "useful" correctly?

options.en: This app is useful for learning words.
Grandma usefuls her phone to call us.
A pencil is a useful for school.
It is very use for my homework.

why.en: Useful is an adjective: this app is useful for … . It is not a verb or a noun.
why.uz: Useful — sifat: this app is useful (bu ilova foydali). U feʼl yoki ot emas.
why.ru: Useful — прилагательное: this app is useful. Это не глагол и не существительное.

stem.en: What does "message" mean?

options.en: a short text you send to somebody
a song that you listen to on the radio

why.en: A message is a short text you send, for example on your phone.
why.uz: Message — xabar: telefon orqali yuboriladigan qisqa matn.
why.ru: Message — сообщение: короткий текст, который отправляют, например, по телефону.

stem.en: Choose the word: "Make the ___ brighter, please. It is too dark, and I cannot read the words."

why.en: You read words on the screen of a phone or a computer, and you can make it brighter.
why.uz: Soʻzlar telefon yoki kompyuter ekranida (screen) oʻqiladi, uni yorqinroq qilish mumkin.
why.ru: Слова читают на экране (screen), и его можно сделать ярче.

stem.en: What does "lonely" mean?

options.en: happy with a lot of friends

why.en: Lonely means sad because you are alone and have nobody to talk to.
why.uz: Lonely — yolgʻiz: yolgʻizlikdan xafa, gaplashadigan odami yoʻq.
why.ru: Lonely — одинокий: грустно, потому что ты один.

stem.en: Choose the word: "Our neighbour always smiles and says hello. She is very ___."

why.en: Somebody who smiles and says hello is kind and nice: friendly.
why.uz: Doim jilmayib salom beradigan odam — friendly, yaʼni xushmuomala.
why.ru: Тот, кто всегда улыбается и здоровается, — friendly, дружелюбный.

stem.en: Choose the word: "Nodir, let me ___ you to my cousin Rustam."

why.en: To introduce people is to tell them each other's names when they first meet.
why.uz: Introduce — tanishtirmoq: ilk bor uchrashganda odamlarga bir-birining ismini aytish.
why.ru: Introduce — знакомить: назвать людям имена друг друга при первой встрече.

stem.en: Choose the word: "Zuhra is ___. She goes red when she talks to new people."

why.en: Going red when you talk to new people is being shy.
why.uz: Yangi odamlar bilan gaplashganda qizarib ketish — shy, yaʼni uyatchanlik.
why.ru: Краснеть, когда говоришь с новыми людьми, — значит быть shy, застенчивым.

stem.en: Choose the right word: "Thank you for ___ me to your party!"

why.en: After "for" we use the -ing form: thank you for inviting me.
why.uz: for dan keyin -ing shakli keladi: thank you for inviting me.
why.ru: После for нужна форма на -ing: thank you for inviting me.

stem.en: In "Aziz felt lonely at the new school", how did Aziz feel?

options.en: sad because he had no friends there
happy because he met new friends
tired because the lessons were long
proud because he got good marks

why.en: Lonely means sad because you are alone: at the new school he had no friends yet.
why.uz: Lonely — yolgʻizlikdan xafa: yangi maktabda hali doʻstlari yoʻq edi.
why.ru: Lonely — одинокий и грустный: в новой школе у него ещё не было друзей.

stem.en: Choose the right word: "The people in this town are ___ to visitors."

why.en: After "are" we need an adjective: friendly. Friend and friendship are nouns.
why.uz: «are» dan keyin sifat kerak: friendly. Friend va friendship — otlar.
why.ru: После are нужно прилагательное: friendly. Friend и friendship — существительные.

stem.en: Which sentence uses "introduce" correctly?

options.en: Can I introduce you to my parents?
Sevara introduced me her older brother.

why.en: We say "introduce somebody to somebody": introduce you to my parents.
why.uz: Inglizchada introduce … to … deyiladi: sizni ota-onam bilan tanishtirmoq.
why.ru: Говорят introduce … to …: познакомить тебя с моими родителями.

stem.en: What does "invite" mean?

options.en: to ask somebody to come or to join you
to say goodbye at the door
to write a long letter to an old friend

why.en: To invite is to ask somebody to come to your home, a party or a game.
why.uz: Invite — taklif qilmoq: kimnidir uyga, bayramga yoki oʻyinga chaqirmoq.
why.ru: Invite — приглашать: звать кого-то в гости, на праздник или в игру.

stem.en: Choose the word: "Grandpa lives alone in the village, and nobody visits him in winter. He often feels ___."

why.en: Living alone with no visitors makes you feel sad and alone: lonely.
why.uz: Yolgʻiz yashab, hech kim kelmasa — lonely, yaʼni odam yolgʻizlikni his qiladi.
why.ru: Когда живёшь один и никто не приходит, чувствуешь себя lonely — одиноко.

stem.en: What is a "slope"?

options.en: the side of a hill or a mountain
the top of a tall building
a flat place next to a lake in a park

why.en: A slope is the side of a hill or a mountain: you can ski down it.
why.uz: Slope — qiyalik, togʻ yonbagʻri: undan changʻida tushish mumkin.
why.ru: Slope — склон горы или холма: с него катаются на лыжах.

stem.en: Choose the word: "During the summer ___ we stayed with our grandparents for a month."

why.en: The days with no school in summer are the summer holiday.
why.uz: Yozda maktabga bormaydigan kunlar — summer holiday (yozgi taʼtil).
why.ru: Летние дни без школы — summer holiday (летние каникулы).

stem.en: Choose the word: "The ___ boy went into the dark room to find the lost kitten."

why.en: Going into a dark room to help a kitten shows he was not afraid: brave.
why.uz: Mushukchani topish uchun qorongʻi xonaga kirish — brave, yaʼni jasurlik.
why.ru: Пойти в тёмную комнату за котёнком — значит быть brave, смелым.

stem.en: Choose the right word: "Be careful on the ice! Yesterday I ___ and hurt my knee."

why.en: Fall is irregular: its past simple is fell. Fallen needs "have" before it.
why.uz: Fall — notoʻgʻri feʼl: past simple shakli fell. Fallen oldidan have kerak.
why.ru: Fall — неправильный глагол: past simple — fell. Перед fallen нужен have.

stem.en: Choose the word: "I cannot ___ where I put my keys. Can you help me look?"

why.en: If you cannot remember, the place is not in your mind, so you need help to look.
why.uz: Remember — eslamoq: kalit qayerdaligini eslay olmasangiz, qidirish uchun yordam kerak.
why.ru: Remember — помнить: если не помнишь, где ключи, нужна помощь в поиске.

stem.en: What is the opposite of "brave"?

why.en: A brave person is not afraid, so afraid is the opposite of brave.
why.uz: Brave (jasur) odam qoʻrqmaydi, shuning uchun afraid (qoʻrqqan) — uning teskarisi.
why.ru: Brave (смелый) человек не боится, поэтому afraid (испуганный) — противоположность.

stem.en: Choose the word: "We climbed up the ___ for an hour, and then we skied down in five minutes."

why.en: You climb up and ski down the side of a mountain: the slope.
why.uz: Togʻ yonbagʻriga chiqib, changʻida pastga tushiladi: slope (qiyalik).
why.ru: Вверх по склону поднимаются, а вниз съезжают на лыжах: slope.

stem.en: Which sentence uses "remember" correctly?

options.en: I remember our first day at school.
Do you remember to the old song?
My sister remembers to the old house.
I am remember his name now.

why.en: Remember takes its thing straight after it: I remember our first day. No "to", and no "am".
why.uz: Remember dan keyin narsa toʻgʻridan-toʻgʻri keladi: I remember our first day. «to» ham, «am» ham kerak emas.
why.ru: После remember сразу идёт предмет: I remember our first day. Без to и без am.

stem.en: What does "fall" mean in "Do not fall off the chair"?

options.en: to drop to the floor by accident
to sit down slowly and carefully
to climb up to the top of it
to stand on it to reach a shelf

why.en: To fall is to drop to the ground or the floor by accident.
why.uz: Fall — yiqilmoq: tasodifan yerga yoki polga tushib ketmoq.
why.ru: Fall — падать: случайно упасть на землю или на пол.

stem.en: Choose the word: "Our school is closed for two weeks in January. It is the winter ___."

why.en: Days with no school are a holiday; in January it is the winter holiday.
why.uz: Maktabga borilmaydigan kunlar — holiday; yanvarda bu qishki taʼtil.
why.ru: Дни без школы — holiday; в январе это зимние каникулы.

stem.en: What does "confident" mean?

options.en: sure that you can do something well
afraid that you will make a mistake
too tired to finish your work
worried about what other people think

why.en: Confident means sure that you can do something well.
why.uz: Confident — oʻziga ishongan: biror ishni yaxshi qila olishiga amin.
why.ru: Confident — уверенный: ты знаешь, что справишься.

stem.en: Choose the word: "Biting your nails is a bad ___ that is hard to stop."

why.en: Something you do again and again without thinking is a habit.
why.uz: Oʻylamasdan qayta-qayta qilinadigan ish — habit, yaʼni odat.
why.ru: То, что делаешь снова и снова не думая, — habit, привычка.

stem.en: Choose the word: "Shahzod checks his essay twice because he does not want to make a ___."

why.en: You check your work twice so that nothing is wrong: you do not want to make a mistake.
why.uz: Ishni ikki marta tekshirish — xato (mistake) qilmaslik uchun.
why.ru: Работу проверяют дважды, чтобы не сделать ошибку: make a mistake.

stem.en: Choose the word: "Everyone ___ mistakes when they learn something new."

why.en: In English we make mistakes; we do not do, take or give them.
why.uz: Inglizchada make a mistake deyiladi, do, take yoki give emas.
why.ru: По-английски говорят make a mistake, а не do, take или give.

stem.en: Choose the right word: "Your English has ___ a lot since September."

why.en: After "has" we need the past participle: has improved.
why.uz: «has» dan keyin uchinchi shakl kerak: has improved (yaxshilandi).
why.ru: После has нужно причастие прошедшего времени: has improved.

stem.en: In "She is making real progress with the violin", what does "making progress" mean?

why.en: To make progress is to get better at something, step by step.
why.uz: Make progress — olgʻa siljimoq: asta-sekin yaxshiroq boʻlib borish.
why.ru: Make progress — делать успехи: шаг за шагом становиться лучше.

stem.en: Choose the right word: "After three months of practice, Nigora spoke ___ in front of the whole school."

why.en: "Spoke" needs an adverb to say how she spoke: confidently.
why.uz: «spoke» qanday gapirganini bildiruvchi ravishni talab qiladi: confidently (ishonch bilan).
why.ru: К spoke нужно наречие — как она говорила: confidently (уверенно).

stem.en: Which sentence uses "progress" correctly?

options.en: Our class has made good progress.
He made three progresses this year.
She is a progress in her studies.
I progress very well last month.

why.en: Progress has no plural and takes no "a": we make good progress.
why.uz: Progress sanalmaydi: «a progress» yoki «progresses» deyilmaydi, make good progress deyiladi.
why.ru: Progress — неисчисляемое: нельзя «a progress» или «progresses», говорят make good progress.

stem.en: What does "improve" mean?

why.en: To improve is to become better or to make something better.
why.uz: Improve — yaxshilanmoq yoki yaxshilamoq.
why.ru: Improve — улучшаться или улучшать что-то.

stem.en: Choose the word: "I am trying to get into the habit ___ drinking more water."

why.en: We say "the habit of" + -ing: the habit of drinking more water.
why.uz: Inglizchada habit of + -ing deyiladi: the habit of drinking more water.
why.ru: Говорят the habit of + -ing: the habit of drinking more water.

stem.en: What is a "device"?

options.en: a machine such as a phone or a laptop
a programme that you watch on television

why.en: A device is a machine such as a phone, a tablet or a laptop.
why.uz: Device — qurilma: telefon, planshet yoki noutbuk kabi mashina.
why.ru: Device — устройство: телефон, планшет или ноутбук.

stem.en: Choose the word: "You need a phone or a laptop for this course. Any ___ with a camera will do."

why.en: A phone or a laptop is a device, so any device with a camera is fine.
why.uz: Telefon yoki noutbuk — device (qurilma): kamerasi bor istalgan qurilma boʻladi.
why.ru: Телефон или ноутбук — это device: подойдёт любое устройство с камерой.

stem.en: Choose the word: "One ___ of living near school is that you can sleep longer."

why.en: Something good that helps you, like more sleep, is an advantage.
why.uz: Sizga yordam beradigan yaxshi tomon, masalan koʻproq uxlash — advantage (afzallik).
why.ru: Хорошая сторона, которая помогает, например больше сна, — advantage (преимущество).

stem.en: Choose the word: "Only teachers have ___ to this room; students need a key."

why.en: Access is the chance to use or enter something: only teachers can enter the room.
why.uz: Access — foydalanish yoki kirish imkoni: xonaga faqat oʻqituvchilar kira oladi.
why.ru: Access — доступ, возможность войти или пользоваться: в комнату входят только учителя.

stem.en: Choose the word: "Turn your phone over while you study, or the messages will ___ you."

why.en: Messages take your attention away from study: they distract you.
why.uz: Xabarlar diqqatni darsdan chalgʻitadi: distract — chalgʻitmoq.
why.ru: Сообщения отвлекают внимание от учёбы: distract — отвлекать.

stem.en: Choose the word: "Every pupil now has access ___ free online books."

why.en: We say "access to something": access to free online books.
why.uz: Inglizchada access to deyiladi: bepul onlayn kitoblardan foydalanish imkoni.
why.ru: Говорят access to: доступ к бесплатным онлайн-книгам.

stem.en: Choose the right word: "The noise from the street was so ___ that I could not finish my reading."

why.en: The noise caused the problem, so we need the -ing adjective: distracting.
why.uz: Shovqin chalgʻitgan, shuning uchun -ing sifati kerak: distracting (chalgʻituvchi).
why.ru: Шум мешал, поэтому нужно прилагательное на -ing: distracting (отвлекающий).

stem.en: Which sentence uses "advantage" correctly?

options.en: Height is an advantage in basketball.
She has many advantage in maths.
It is very advantage to study online.
He is an advantage student in class.

why.en: Advantage is a noun: something is an advantage. It is not an adjective, and after "many" it is advantages.
why.uz: Advantage — ot: «is an advantage» deyiladi. U sifat emas, many dan keyin esa advantages.
why.ru: Advantage — существительное: «is an advantage». Это не прилагательное, а после many — advantages.

stem.en: What does "distract" mean?

options.en: to help you listen more carefully
to turn off a phone or a laptop

why.en: To distract is to take your attention away from what you are doing.
why.uz: Distract — chalgʻitmoq: diqqatni qilayotgan ishdan olib qochmoq.
why.ru: Distract — отвлекать: уводить внимание от того, чем ты занят.

stem.en: Choose the word: "The video call kept freezing because of a weak internet ___."

why.en: A weak link to the internet makes a video call stop: a weak connection.
why.uz: Internet bilan aloqa (connection) kuchsiz boʻlsa, video qoʻngʻiroq toʻxtab qoladi.
why.ru: Если связь с интернетом (connection) слабая, видеозвонок зависает.

stem.en: What does "reduce" mean?

options.en: to make something smaller or less
to make something bigger or more
to move something to a new place

why.en: To reduce is to make something smaller or less, for example noise.
why.uz: Reduce — kamaytirmoq: biror narsani kichikroq yoki kamroq qilmoq.
why.ru: Reduce — уменьшать, сокращать: делать меньше.

stem.en: Choose the words: "Buses, trams and the metro are all kinds of ___."

why.en: Buses, trams and the metro are transport that everyone can use: public transport.
why.uz: Avtobus, tramvay va metro — hamma foydalanadigan jamoat transporti (public transport).
why.ru: Автобусы, трамваи и метро — общественный транспорт (public transport).

stem.en: Choose the word: "There was so much ___ on the road that our taxi hardly moved."

why.en: Many cars on the road that move slowly are heavy traffic.
why.uz: Yoʻlda sekin yurgan koʻp mashinalar — traffic (yoʻl harakati, tirbandlik).
why.ru: Много медленных машин на дороге — это traffic (пробки, движение).

stem.en: Choose the word: "The factory was closed because the ___ it caused made the river dangerous for fish."

why.en: Dirty water that harms fish is pollution.
why.uz: Baliqlarga zarar beradigan iflos suv — pollution (ifloslanish).
why.ru: Грязная вода, опасная для рыбы, — это pollution (загрязнение).

stem.en: Choose the word: "Akmal's ___ is long: he takes two buses to get to school every morning."

why.en: His regular trip to school is his commute, and with two buses it is long.
why.uz: Har kungi maktabga qatnov yoʻli — commute; ikki avtobus bilan u uzoq.
why.ru: Ежедневная дорога в школу — commute; с двумя автобусами она долгая.

stem.en: Choose the right word: "The new bus lane has led to a big ___ in traffic."

why.en: After "a big" we need a noun: a reduction, a fall in the number.
why.uz: «a big» dan keyin ot kerak: reduction (kamayish).
why.ru: После «a big» нужно существительное: reduction (сокращение).

stem.en: Choose the right word: "Traffic is ___ in the city centre at eight than at noon."

why.en: We say "heavy traffic", and with "than" we need the comparative: heavier.
why.uz: Inglizchada heavy traffic deyiladi; than bilan qiyosiy daraja kerak: heavier.
why.ru: Говорят heavy traffic; с than нужна сравнительная степень: heavier.

stem.en: Which sentence uses "commute" correctly?

options.en: Her commute takes half an hour by bus.
I commute is long every morning.
Our commute to the sea in July was fun.
She commutes the bus every day.

why.en: A commute is a regular trip to work or school, so a holiday trip to the sea is not one.
why.uz: Commute — ishga yoki oʻqishga har kungi qatnov; dengizga taʼtil safari commute emas.
why.ru: Commute — регулярная поездка на работу или учёбу; поездка на море в отпуск — не commute.

stem.en: In "Air pollution is a problem in big cities", what is "pollution"?

options.en: too many cars in a small street

why.en: Pollution is dirty air, water or land; air pollution is dirty air.
why.uz: Pollution — havo, suv yoki yerning ifloslanishi; air pollution — havoning ifloslanishi.
why.ru: Pollution — загрязнение воздуха, воды или земли; air pollution — грязный воздух.

stem.en: Choose the word: "Sharing a car with neighbours is one way to ___ the number of cars on our street."

why.en: When neighbours share one car, fewer cars are on the street: it reduces their number.
why.uz: Qoʻshnilar bitta mashinadan foydalansa, koʻchada mashina kamayadi: reduce — kamaytirmoq.
why.ru: Если соседи ездят на одной машине, машин становится меньше: reduce — сокращать.

stem.en: What is a "leak"?

options.en: a hole that lets water out
a tap that gives hot water
a pipe that brings gas in

why.en: A leak is a small hole or crack that lets water or gas get out.
why.uz: Leak — suv yoki gaz sizib chiqadigan kichik teshik.
why.ru: Leak — течь: маленькое отверстие, через которое выходит вода или газ.

stem.en: Choose the word: "Wear a hat in summer to ___ your head from the sun."

why.en: To protect is to keep safe: a hat keeps your head safe from the sun.
why.uz: Protect — himoya qilmoq: shlyapa boshni quyoshdan asraydi.
why.ru: Protect — защищать: шляпа защищает голову от солнца.

stem.en: Choose the word: "Because of the dry summer, there is a ___ of water in many villages."

why.en: A dry summer means not enough water: a shortage of water.
why.uz: Quruq yoz — suv yetishmaydi: shortage of water (suv tanqisligi).
why.ru: Сухое лето — воды не хватает: shortage of water (нехватка воды).

stem.en: Choose the word: "A big fridge ___ more electricity than a small one."

why.en: To consume is to use something such as energy: a big fridge uses more electricity.
why.uz: Consume — sarflamoq, isteʼmol qilmoq: katta muzlatgich koʻproq elektr sarflaydi.
why.ru: Consume — потреблять: большой холодильник тратит больше электричества.

stem.en: Choose the word: "Clean water is a ___ that every family needs, so we must not waste it."

why.en: Clean water is something useful that people need and have: a resource.
why.uz: Toza suv — hamma uchun zarur boylik: resource (resurs).
why.ru: Чистая вода — нужное всем богатство: resource (ресурс).

stem.en: Choose the word: "There is water on the bathroom floor. I think the pipe under the sink is ___."

why.en: Water on the floor under a pipe shows that water is getting out: the pipe is leaking.
why.uz: Quvur ostida suv — suv sizib chiqyapti: the pipe is leaking.
why.ru: Вода на полу под трубой: вода вытекает, труба leaking — протекает.

stem.en: Choose the word: "Sunglasses protect your eyes ___ strong light."

why.en: We say "protect something from a danger": protect your eyes from strong light.
why.uz: Inglizchada protect … from deyiladi: koʻzni kuchli yorugʻlikdan himoya qilmoq.
why.ru: Говорят protect … from: защищать глаза от яркого света.

stem.en: Which sentence uses "shortage" correctly?

options.en: The town has a shortage of nurses.
The pipe has a shortage, so water drips.
We have shortage water in summer.
This road is a shortage to the bazaar.

why.en: A shortage is not having enough of something: a shortage of nurses. A hole in a pipe is a leak.
why.uz: Shortage — yetishmovchilik: a shortage of nurses. Quvurdagi teshik esa leak.
why.ru: Shortage — нехватка: a shortage of nurses. А дырка в трубе — это leak.

stem.en: What does "consume" mean?

options.en: to use something such as water or energy
to make something new from old things
to give something to people who need it

why.en: To consume is to use something such as water, food or energy.
why.uz: Consume — isteʼmol qilmoq, sarflamoq: suv, ovqat yoki energiyani.
why.ru: Consume — потреблять: тратить воду, еду или энергию.

stem.en: Choose the right word: "Water, gas and oil are natural ___."

why.en: Water, gas and oil are more than one thing, so we need the plural: resources.
why.uz: Suv, gaz va neft — bir nechta narsa, shuning uchun koʻplik kerak: resources.
why.ru: Вода, газ и нефть — несколько вещей, поэтому нужно множественное число: resources.

stem.en: What does "luggage" mean?

options.en: the bags you take when you travel
the ticket you show on a train
the person who checks tickets on a train

why.en: Luggage is the bags and cases you take with you on a trip.
why.uz: Luggage — yuk, bagaj: safarda olib yuriladigan sumka va chamadonlar.
why.ru: Luggage — багаж: сумки и чемоданы, которые берут в поездку.

stem.en: Choose the word: "The ___ to my uncle's village is long, so we take sandwiches."

why.en: The trip from one place to another is a journey.
why.uz: Bir joydan boshqa joyga safar — journey (yoʻl, safar).
why.ru: Поездка из одного места в другое — journey (путь, поездка).

stem.en: Choose the word: "Our train is late. The board shows a ___ of twenty minutes."

why.en: When a train is late, the extra time is a delay.
why.uz: Poyezd kechiksa, ortiqcha vaqt — delay (kechikish).
why.ru: Если поезд опаздывает, это delay (задержка).

stem.en: Choose the word: "We should ___ our tickets now, before all the seats are sold."

why.en: To book is to arrange a seat in advance, before the tickets are sold out.
why.uz: Book — oldindan band qilmoq: chiptalar sotilib ketmasidan oldin.
why.ru: Book — бронировать заранее, пока билеты не распроданы.

stem.en: In "Samarkand was our final destination", what was Samarkand?

options.en: the place we were travelling to
the city where we bought our tickets

why.en: A destination is the place you are travelling to; "final" means the last one.
why.uz: Destination — boriladigan manzil; final — oxirgi.
why.ru: Destination — пункт назначения, место, куда едешь; final — последний.

stem.en: Choose the word: "We had too much ___, so we paid extra for one bag."

why.en: Bags you take on a trip are luggage; too many bags cost extra.
why.uz: Safardagi sumkalar — luggage; ortiqcha yuk uchun qoʻshimcha pul toʻlanadi.
why.ru: Сумки в поездке — luggage; за лишний багаж доплачивают.

stem.en: Choose the right word: "The bus was ___ for two hours because of the snow."

why.en: "Was" + past participle makes the passive: the bus was delayed.
why.uz: «was» + uchinchi shakl — majhul nisbat: the bus was delayed (kechiktirildi).
why.ru: Was + причастие — пассив: the bus was delayed (автобус задержали).

stem.en: Which sentence uses "journey" correctly?

options.en: Our journey home took four hours.
We journey the train every summer.
I put my journey under the seat.
She made a journey of her ticket.

why.en: A journey is a trip from one place to another: our journey home. You cannot put it under a seat.
why.uz: Journey — bir joydan boshqasiga safar: our journey home. Uni oʻrindiq ostiga qoʻyib boʻlmaydi.
why.ru: Journey — поездка: our journey home. Её нельзя положить под сиденье.

stem.en: What does "book" mean in "book a room"?

options.en: to write about it in a diary

why.en: Here book is a verb: to arrange to have a room or a seat in advance.
why.uz: Bu yerda book — feʼl: xonani yoki joyni oldindan band qilmoq.
why.ru: Здесь book — глагол: заранее забронировать номер или место.

stem.en: Choose the word: "After six hours on the road we finally reached our ___: a small guesthouse by the lake."

why.en: The place you are travelling to is your destination: you reach it at the end.
why.uz: Boriladigan manzil — destination: yoʻl oxirida unga yetib boriladi.
why.ru: Место, куда едешь, — destination: его достигают в конце пути.

stem.en: What does "routine" mean?

options.en: your usual order of doing things
a long sleep at the weekend
a sudden change in your plans
a list of new words to learn by heart

why.en: A routine is the usual order in which you do things every day.
why.uz: Routine — kun tartibi: har kuni ishlarni bajarishning odatiy tartibi.
why.ru: Routine — распорядок: обычный порядок дел каждый день.

stem.en: Choose the word: "A ___ of water makes plants dry and yellow."

why.en: Not having enough water is a lack of water.
why.uz: Suv yetishmasligi — lack of water.
why.ru: Нехватка воды — lack of water.

stem.en: Choose the word: "In a quiet library it is easier to ___ on your reading."

why.en: To concentrate is to give all your attention to one thing, here your reading.
why.uz: Concentrate — diqqatni jamlamoq: butun eʼtiborni oʻqishga qaratmoq.
why.ru: Concentrate — сосредоточиться: направить всё внимание на чтение.

stem.en: Choose the word: "Loud music late at night can ___ how well you sleep."

why.en: To affect is to change or influence something: loud music changes your sleep.
why.uz: Affect — taʼsir qilmoq: baland musiqa uyquga taʼsir qiladi.
why.ru: Affect — влиять: громкая музыка влияет на сон.

stem.en: Choose the word: "After the long race, the runners rested for a day to ___."

why.en: To recover is to become strong again: the runners rested to get their strength back.
why.uz: Recover — tiklanmoq: yuguruvchilar kuchini qayta tiklash uchun dam oldi.
why.ru: Recover — восстанавливаться: бегуны отдыхали, чтобы вернуть силы.

stem.en: Choose the word: "She is recovering ___ a bad cold, so she is staying at home today."

why.en: We say "recover from" an illness: recovering from a bad cold.
why.uz: Inglizchada recover from deyiladi: kasallikdan tuzalmoq.
why.ru: Говорят recover from: выздоравливать от простуды.

stem.en: Choose the right word: "Too much screen time can have a bad ___ on your sleep."

why.en: After "a bad" we need a noun: effect. Affect is the verb: it can affect your sleep.
why.uz: «a bad» dan keyin ot kerak: effect (taʼsir). Affect esa feʼl: it can affect your sleep.
why.ru: После «a bad» нужно существительное effect. Affect — глагол: it can affect your sleep.

stem.en: Which sentence uses "lack" correctly?

options.en: He is tired from a lack of sleep.
We lack of time this week.
There is a lack sugar in the cake.
She lacks to finish her homework.

why.en: As a noun we say "a lack of sleep"; as a verb, lack takes no "of": we lack time.
why.uz: Ot sifatida «a lack of sleep» deyiladi; feʼl sifatida of kerak emas: we lack time.
why.ru: Существительное: a lack of sleep; глагол — без of: we lack time.

stem.en: What does "affect" mean?

options.en: to stay the same for a long time

why.en: To affect something is to change or influence it, for example your mood.
why.uz: Affect — taʼsir qilmoq: biror narsani oʻzgartirmoq, masalan kayfiyatni.
why.ru: Affect — влиять: менять что-то, например настроение.

stem.en: Choose the word: "Every night Javlon reads, brushes his teeth and turns off the light at ten. This bedtime ___ helps him sleep well."

why.en: The same steps in the same order every night are a routine.
why.uz: Har kecha bir xil tartibdagi ishlar — routine (kun tartibi).
why.ru: Одни и те же действия в одном порядке каждый вечер — это routine.
